sources.citation: Aikhenvald, Alexandra Y. 2008. The Manambu language of East Sepik, Papua New Guinea. Oxford: OUP. Ch.1, note 3 (Ndu languages overview).
sources.note: Nothing on Burui stress. Identity only: '(Burui, Maligwat, and Gaikundi, listed as separate Ndu languages on the Ethnologue website, are among the Iatmul dialects.)... of these, Sengo, Burui, Kwaruwi Kundi, and also Gaikundi appear to be members of the Iatmul continuum.' Refers to Staalsen (1975) for the Sawos reappraisal.
